segments.en: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod.

segments.en: My name is Marco.

segments.en: And I'm Erika.
segments.zh: 我叫 Erika。

segments.en: And today we're bringing you another part of our sports series and today we're going to be talking about volleyball.
segments.zh: 今天我们将为您带来我们体育系列的另一部分，今天我们将谈论排球。

segments.zh: 因此，我们将研究一些与排球相关的精彩单词和短语，以及如何描述体育赛事。

segments.en: So before we start on the dialogue, let's take a look at two words on vocabulary preview.

segments.en: Encounter.

segments.en: An exciting encounter.
segments.zh: 激动人心的相遇。

segments.en: All right, so if we have an exciting encounter, it means we have an exciting meeting of two people or two teams or two groups.
segments.zh: 好，所以 an exciting encounter 指的是两个人、两支队伍或两个团体之间激动人心的交锋。

segments.en: If I say I had an incredible encounter last night with my best friend.

segments.en: You met up with your best friend and something happened.

segments.en: So a powerhouse team is basically a strong, powerful, really energetic, great team, right?

segments.en: Okay, so we can use it for teams such as in this case, but we can also describe maybe a company or a person as a powerhouse.
segments.zh: 好，所以我们可以用它来形容像这样的队伍，也可以把一家公司或一个人形容为 powerhouse。

segments.en: So a set or to set.

segments.en: And again, you take the ball and you move it with the tips of your fingers.

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: That is done by the setter.
segments.zh: 这是由setter完成的。

segments.en: And he does this, he sets the ball, so then the attacker can spike the ball.
segments.zh: 他这样做了，他设置了球，这样攻击者就可以将球钉住。

segments.en: That's our next word, to spike.
segments.zh: 这就是我们的下一个词，to spike。

segments.en: So to spike the ball.

segments.en: Or a spike.

segments.en: Right.

segments.en: And it's basically to start the game by hitting it to the other side.
segments.zh: 它基本上是通过将其击到另一边来开始游戏。

segments.en: Jump serve.

segments.en: Jump serve.
segments.zh: 跳发球。

segments.en: Now this is very popular and you will see some players do this.

segments.en: They will throw the ball in the air and then jump in the air and hit it.
segments.zh: 他们会把球扔到空中，然后跳到空中并击中它。

segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's a jump serve.

segments.en: And our last word for today is let's serve.
segments.zh: 我们今天的最后一个词是 let serve。

segments.en: A let serve.

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We have a let serve today.
segments.zh: 今天我们遇到了一个发球擦网。

segments.en: So a let's serve is when you serve the ball and it sort of brushes over the net.
segments.zh: let serve 指的是发球时球轻轻擦到网。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It'll hit the net but it will still pass to the other side.
segments.zh: 它会击中网，但它仍然会传到另一边。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And that's an illegal move in volleyball, isn't it?
segments.zh: 这在排球里是犯规的，对吧？

segments.en: When you are serving, yes.

segments.en: So a let serve.

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.zh: 所以这些是我们今天要研究的与排球有关的六个术语。

segments.zh: 它节奏很快，也很费体力。

segments.en: But it's very interesting to get together with friends, maybe at the beach and play some beach volleyball or something like that.
segments.zh: 但是和朋友聚在一起很有趣，也许在海滩上打沙滩排球或类似的东西。

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's the best place to play volleyball.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是打排球的最佳场所。

segments.en: You know, we even have beach volleyball up in freezing cold Canada.
segments.zh: 你知道，我们甚至在寒冷的加拿大有沙滩排球。

segments.en: And do you have sand?
segments.zh: 你有沙子吗？

segments.en: Occasionally.
segments.zh: 偶尔。

segments.en: All right, so volleyball is a great sport, but now we want to know what sport you want to learn about.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以排球是一项很棒的运动，但现在我们想知道你想了解什么运动。

segments.en: We've covered soccer, we've covered basketball, we've covered volleyball.
segments.zh: 我们已经报道了足球，我们已经报道了篮球，我们已经报道了排球。

segments.en: So tell us what other sports you would like to learn vocabulary and phrases on.
segments.zh: 所以请告诉我们，你还想学哪些其他运动的词汇和短语。

segments.en: That's right, you can tell us this and many more things at EnglishPod.com, our website.
segments.zh: 没错，你可以在我们的网站 EnglishPod.com 上告诉我们这些以及更多内容。

segments.en: So check it out.
segments.zh: 那么来看看。

segments.en: Right, leave your questions and comments and we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 对，留下您的问题和评论，我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Thanks for downloading and until next time, goodbye!
segments.zh: 感谢您的下载，直到下一次，再见！
